errors.quote: Total paid leave payout equals $2,520.00 based on standard hourly rate
errors.explanation: The payout covers 54.0 hours at $45.00 per hour, which equals $2,430.00, not $2,520.00.
errors.fix: Total paid leave payout equals $2,430.00 based on standard hourly rate

errors.quote: HRMS core record updated from Active to Resigned in system tables
errors.explanation: The employee profile table explicitly specifies the separation type as Involuntary - Restructuring, so recording the status as Resigned contradicts the document's own data.
errors.fix: HRMS core record updated from Active to Terminated - Involuntary in system tables

errors.quote: Issue standard COBRA election packet within 60 days of the qualifying event
errors.explanation: Under federal COBRA regulations, an employer group health plan administrator must provide the COBRA election notice within 14 days of receiving notice of the qualifying event (or 44 days if the employer is the plan administrator), not 60 days. The 60-day window applies to the employee's election period.
errors.fix: Issue standard COBRA election packet within 14 days of the qualifying event
